connector.name: Variel MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Generate your brand in-agent, then keep tokens, components, and copy on-brand over MCP.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.variel, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: BRAND_API_KEY
env.description: Your Variel project API key (bsk_…) to connect an existing brand. Get it from your Variel dashboard, or run `variel-mcp login` to provision one via browser sign-in (no copy-paste). You can also start keyless and generate a brand with generate_brand_kickoff.

env.name: VARIEL_API_URL
env.description: Override the Variel API base URL. Defaults to https://variel.ai. Optional — for self-hosted or staging.

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.description: Anthropic API key. Required only for grade_visual_quality, generate_component, and Tier-2 validate_copy. Optional for all other tools.
